:::{#def-wald-ci}
#### Wald confidence interval

The approximate $100(1-\alpha)\%$ **Wald confidence interval**
for the $k$th entry $\theta_k$ of a parameter vector is

$$
\hth_k \pm z_{1 - \alpha/2} \times \HSE{\hth_k}
$$

where $\hth_k$ is the $k$th entry of $\hthml$,
$\HSE{\hth_k}$ is its estimated standard error,
and $z_{\beta}$ is the $\beta$ quantile of the standard Gaussian distribution.
:::
